title: Planar Homebrew
description: The homebrew rules of our Turn of Fortune's Wheel table, for dnd5e: Silver Eagle Resonance (matching weapon dice chain), Bound Companions (a familiar or vestige manifested by casting, with GM approval), Portable Light Sources (per-item light, ignitions and burn time) and Blind Death Saves (secret GM rolls, handed to Planar Glitch on a death). Campaign-specific by design.

recommends.reason: A hero who dies on blind death saves is handed to Planar Glitch (body, Wheel, glitch), which can't see secret failures by itself.
